proposals.boundary: Not a universal lossless tracer: no GPU-device stacks, retrospective unprepared history, automatic global MPI launch, or per-event durable acknowledgement. Budget exhaustion is partial and crashes may leave uncommitted tails.
Unsupported relations and missing evidence remain gaps; no whole-program proof of causality.
Missing ranks, unsupported callbacks and loss prevent a complete audit.
The fixed-workload model requires calibration and held-out acceptance; arbitrary scheduler/program prediction is unsupported.
Scientific tolerances must be supplied; no universal numerical-error guarantee.
Requires an explicit repeated failure oracle; no universal input/rank/language minimizer.
Repeated measured trials preserve uncertainty; no automatic attribution to one changed line.
Applications must declare safe points and handle deadlines and uncertain outcomes.
Application-owned safe points and existing communication groups are required; partial commits are uncertain.
Missing lineage stays uncertain; proposed revalidation does not prove a scientific claim.
Deterministic greedy planning over supplied action models; not an optimal learned investigator.
**External gate:** newcomer task study; no measured usability improvement claimed.
Session back stacks remain transient; narrow screens omit optional context before hiding the current page/job.
**Partial:** contextual input handlers, raw-key dispatch and specialist controls remain module-owned with their own validation; trusted plugins keep their separate dispatch contract.
Sample coverage is bounded and source-specific; native Research analyses still establish scientific applicability.
Original text, source order and unknown clock domains remain distinct; no automatic universal log parser or cross-clock causal order.
Full arbitrary-volume scientific visualization remains outside the terminal core.
**External gate:** real emulator, multiplexer, font and assistive-technology qualification.
**Partial:** geometry, attempt checks, previews, rollback and validation remain in the existing per-control state machines; terminal byte decoding retains its established protocol.
**Partial:** unmanaged extension writes retain exact content checking or uncached fallback; other Store fields and full document composition are not universally incremental.

Bounded documents may recompose to establish valid geometry after a first publication or scrolled resize. Other panes retain specialized renderers; no unbounded or universally incremental document promise.
Adapter/service processes retain their explicit resource contracts; not every external tool obeys Python worker counts.
**External gate:** release-target performance on actual terminals and SSH; targets are not results.
Filesystem/node failure can still lose uncommitted state; external transports have separate replay contracts.
**Partial:** no deterministic recording of every OS scheduling event or arbitrary external application.
A valid schema checks supplied evidence; it cannot prove a producer measured correctly.
Claims must be qualified against the installed runtime, build and site.
**Partial:** no universal Caliper/OMPT/Kokkos/GPU injector. PMPI supports its declared C signatures/rank limit; unsupported operations produce gaps.
Installed code remains trusted; isolation is not a security sandbox.
**External gate:** target-site authentication, deployment and label mappings; no blanket Jobstats, ClusterCockpit, LLview or slurmrestd client certification.
Binary Perfetto/protobuf, arbitrary Caliper formats and general JSON-LD expansion are not implied.
A user-scoped broker is not an institution-wide authenticated monitoring service.
**Partial:** abstain on loss, missing ranks or unsupported callbacks; no whole-program proof of causality.
Line-deletion minimization needs an explicit repeated failure oracle; no universal input/rank/language minimizer or automatic attribution to one changed line.
No invented scientific threshold; no universal numerical-error bound or automatic perturbation of arbitrary binaries.
**Research gate:** limited fixed-workload model; missing policy/evidence stays unqualified. No arbitrary-program or scheduler prediction.
Deterministic greedy planning over supplied models; not a learned optimal Bayesian investigator.
Missing lineage remains uncertain; proposed checks do not prove a scientific claim.
Private leader-local mailbox; existing MPI/PyTorch process group is required. Partial commits become uncertain, not rolled back or automatically retried.
Cooperative policy is not OS-enforced privilege isolation.
Estimated cost requires target-system measurement; strict completeness is never inferred from interval alone.
Multi-step scheduler/filesystem effects are not a distributed transaction; uncertain outcomes require reconciliation.
**Partial:** no unauthenticated shared session, universal redactor or automatic upload. Review before sharing.
Hashes detect changes, not publisher authenticity. Signing and separately installed external runtime/tool inventories remain release/site responsibilities.
**External gate:** real GPU, multi-node, production SSH and site policy tests remain explicit untested entries.
Schema and control changes require reference regeneration and compatibility review.
**External gate:** multi-node/PyTorch/CUDA/NCCL and site qualification; CUDA metric tests use fake events and do not certify hardware sampling.
**External gate:** publish target-system tail latency, memory/RPC cost and real workload outcomes.
Maintainer capacity and long-term compatibility depend on actual maintained releases.
**External gate:** independent labs/operators have not been recruited or evaluated by this implementation.
**External gate:** no scientific study, superiority result or world-first claim has been established.
Compare incorrect endorsement and resource cost with expert/rule baselines; a predicate checker is not a proof of universal validity.
Evaluate information utility, calibration, noise and regret. Current planner is deterministic greedy, not optimal learning.
Compare against full recomputation with seeded parser/input/policy changes; no unjustified minimality claim.
Execute reviewed recipes on independently configured sites; portability of JSON alone is not diagnostic equivalence.
Validate query families against complete reference data and rare events; cannot answer arbitrary discarded-history queries.

deferred_paths.clusters: Live multi-cluster collection needs a governed shared source adapter.
deferred_paths.supervisor:start: A detached collector needs its own governed source owner.
deferred_paths.site-telemetry:query: Network telemetry needs its own request/response ledger.
deferred_paths.environment:probe_job_id: Compute-host probes need a governed target adapter; artifact-only inspection works.
deferred_paths.environment:apply: Environment publication needs a reviewed bounded worker artifact adapter.
deferred_paths.checkpoint/search/packing/dask/heterogen: Campaign submissions need a reviewed worker-to-scheduler handoff.
deferred_paths.diagnostic-campaign/minimize-reproducer/: External drivers need an owned, bounded execution adapter.
Driver control belongs to the original execution host.
deferred_paths.staging:apply: Transfers need a reviewed worker I/O budget and destination handoff.
deferred_paths.adapter:apply: Plugin execution needs an explicit declared adapter.
deferred_paths.trace recorder outside a verified job-lo: Python/native capture needs fresh owned job/step and current process membership. Inspect reads a bounded prefix; register and SDK output remain Light.
deferred_paths.diagnostic/diagnostic-trials CLI: External experiments need a reviewed owned execution target.
deferred_paths.report exec/passport/aggregate outside a: These run inside a verified owned Slurm job/step. Report submit uses the governed scheduler ledger without requiring Heavy; bounded metadata reports remain Light.
deferred_paths.passport capture outside a verified job-: Repository/input capture needs an explicit owned job-local execution target.
deferred_paths.terminal generated helpers: Arbitrary generated shell commands cannot substitute for named worker operations; user input and local hooks remain available.
deferred_paths.large remote artifacts: No implicit mapping between interface, SSH, and worker paths.
deferred_paths.absolute log line/time seek above 2 MiB: Use byte/percent windows or admitted Heavy search.
deferred_paths.direct whole-file copy above 2 MiB: Use the admitted Heavy log-bundle export.
